additional_info.subject: ID0477823-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/TN4002939783] Charging Issue CRM:03289000538
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
Thank you for the update regarding the charger.
Following your request, and after checking the charging session, we have come to an answer to why the transferred power was 0kw.
In the following log you are able to see that during the pre-charge fase the maximum power was reached from the charger, which means the charger is able to provided a maximum of 400kw power.
After the pre-charge fase, the charging session started, and the charger was following the requests from the car. In the following log, you are able to see that from the first second that the charging session started, the car didn`t request any power from the charger, so the charger also didn`t provided any power. The percentage of charging was already set on 99%.
This means that the charger is working how it is supposed to be, but the car was not providing the charger with the information needed. The charger was following the request from the car.
We hope to have provided you with enough information.
Please provide us with feedback, so we are able to close the ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
